name: ActionsBench
description: A labeled corpus of minimized GitHub Actions workflows, each tagged with the weakness it contains or marked clean, and a harness that scores workflow security scanners against it per weakness class. The corpus is licensed CC BY 4.0, which is the license named here, and the harness code is licensed MIT; both licenses ship with the package. Version 0.1.1 is an initial release (pre-1.0) of 44 hand-built cases: all labels are proposed by one author and audited against primary sources, but not independently reviewed.
